metadata.name: Ronald Reagan
metadata.description: US president associated with tax reductions, market-oriented reforms, military expansion and late Cold War arms negotiations.
metadata.scope: Personal positions and governing conduct during 1981–1989; earlier writings are contextual only. Historical analogies to contemporary technologies are explicitly inferred, not claims that the subject answered a modern questionnaire. Coalition constraints and contradictions are identified by axis.
